lockdown: Lockdown Mode looks to be on, and it turns off what Ghostly needs. Turn it off for this site, then reload.
lockdownHow: How to turn it off for this site
lockdownOtherBrowser: Other browsers on iPhone or iPad: Settings › Privacy & Security › Lockdown Mode › Configure Web Browsing, and turn it off for that browser.
lockdownSafari: Safari: tap aA in the address bar, then Website Settings, and turn Lockdown Mode off (on a Mac: Safari › Settings for This Website).
missingCrypto: Web Crypto is off. It works only on a secure (https) address.
missingIndexedDB: IndexedDB is off or blocked, so chats and keys can't be saved.
missingLocks: Web Locks is missing, so Ghostly can't make sure it runs only once.
missingStorage: Site data is blocked, so nothing can be saved.
otherTab: Ghostly is already open in another tab.
otherTabHint: Close it and this tab takes over.
reloadUnreachable: Can't reach Ghostly's server. Check your connection, then reload.
shared: Sent to Ghostly in your other tab.
sharedHint: Pick the chat there. You can close this one.
title: Ghostly can't run in this browser
tryOther: Leave private mode and allow site data, update the browser, or open Ghostly in another one.
trySecure: Open Ghostly at its https:// address.
